# ARENOVA

> AI Automation & Marketing Agency — Enterprise Systems Architecture, Performance Marketing, and Autonomous Operations.

ARENOVA builds high-converting marketing engines (Meta Ads & Google Ads) paired with 24/7 AI front desk automation and autonomous operations to capture qualified leads, eliminate manual data entry, and scale enterprise revenue.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [AI Front Desk Agents](https://arenova.in/#services): 24/7 voice and chat agents that greet, qualify, book, and route inquiries across phone, web chat, SMS, and WhatsApp with zero hallucination. Integrates with Twilio Voice, WhatsApp Business, Calendly, Acuity, and HubSpot.
- [Workflow Automation](https://arenova.in/#services): End-to-end operational pipelines connecting CRMs, payment gateways, scheduling, and fulfillment without manual re-entry. Two-way data synchronization across Make.com, Zapier Enterprise, Stripe, and PostgreSQL.
- [Custom AI Agents](https://arenova.in/#services): Domain-specific autonomous agents trained on proprietary company knowledge, vector embeddings, and enterprise SOPs with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
- [Performance Marketing & Revenue Engines](https://arenova.in/#marketing): High-impact Meta Ads (paid social) and high-intent Google Ads (Search & PMax) paired with conversion-engineered landing pages and sub-15-second automated lead response.
- [Conversion-Engineered Web Experiences](https://arenova.in/#services): High-speed, cinematic, high-converting digital platforms engineered for enterprise credibility and conversion optimization.

## Arenova Product Ecosystem

Arenova is the parent company and systems engineering agency. The ecosystem includes specialized products:

- [Arenova Frontdesk](https://frontdesk.arenova.in): AI-powered WhatsApp receptionist and appointment automation for clinics and service businesses.
- [Arova](https://arova.arenova.in): B2B lead intelligence and qualified business leads discovery platform.
- [Outreacher](https://outreacher.arenova.in): Email outreach and sales automation platform for high-velocity teams.

## Key Operational Metrics

- Lead-to-Contact Velocity: Under 15 seconds
- Average Campaign ROAS: 4.8x across active paid social campaigns
- Wasted Spend Reduction: -38% through negative keyword moats and intent filtering
- System Availability: 99.98% SLA across marketing and automation clusters
